snippet.title: The Newest, Crispiest Idle RPG 🍪ㅣCookieRun: Crumble Official PV
snippet.description:
CookieRun: Crumble is coming up fast!
And it's set to be the crispiest hands-off RPG adventure yet! 🤭

King Choco Drop asks a straggling Mercenary Guild to handle the crumbs left behind by the great heroes, but somehow, even that proves hard for them as they bicker their way through the beginning of their adventure.

To top it all off, they managed to cause part of the castle to collapse as they cleaned, getting shoulder with piles and piles of Coin debt! Join these mercenary Cookies as they complete all sorts of odd jobs and commissions in an attempt to make up their debts ⚔️

Will they manage to clear their debts and become true heroes, or are they really as hopeless as they seem?!
#CookieRun #CookieRunCrumble #IdleRPG
